summary.zh: 深入恢复拿到野性成长、迅捷治愈与更强的持续治疗，再从平衡系拿起源和自然的壮美延长它们。
summary.en: Deep Restoration for Wild Growth, Swiftmend, and stronger heal-over-time spells, with Genesis and Nature's Splendor from Balance to extend them.

scenario.zh: 60 级在地下城与团本中治疗
scenario.en: Level 60 healing in dungeons and raids

pros.zh: 自然赐福让全部治疗效果提高 10%，强化回春术让回春术提高 15%，起源再让所有持续治疗提高 5%。
pros.en: Gift of Nature raises all your healing by 10%, Improved Rejuvenation adds 15% to Rejuvenation, and Genesis adds 5% to every heal over time.

pros.zh: 自然的壮美让回春术持续时间延长 3 秒、愈合延长 6 秒，每次施放覆盖更长的战斗。
pros.en: Nature's Splendor adds 3 seconds to Rejuvenation and 6 seconds to Regrowth, so each cast covers more of the fight.

pros.zh: 反射让施法时保留一半法力恢复；生命之魂提高 15% 精神。
pros.en: Reflection keeps half your mana regeneration running while casting; Living Spirit adds 15% Spirit.

pros.zh: 迅捷治愈、自然迅捷与野性成长提供瞬发的急救手段和全队持续治疗。
pros.en: Swiftmend, Nature's Swiftness, and Wild Growth give you an instant emergency heal and a party-wide heal over time.

pros.zh: 月光只对伤害法术有效，这 3 点是为了解锁自然的壮美。不需要自然的壮美时，可把这 4 点改投强化宁静、微妙与激怒。
pros.en: Moonglow only helps damage spells; its three points are there to reach Nature's Splendor. If you skip Splendor, spend those four points on Improved Tranquility, Subtlety, and Furor.
